lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: typescript-express-flowise-stripe-id-without-session-ownership-check
title: Stripe subscriptionId/customerId from request used in identityManager without matching the session's
  organization
summary: Controller handlers read a Stripe subscriptionId or customerId from req.query or req.body and
  pass it straight to identityManager billing calls. They never check that the ID belongs to the caller's
  active organization. An authenticated user can read or modify billing data, seats and plans of other
  tenants (IDOR). The tenant request guards module also lacks the helper that enforces this check.
cwe:
- CWE-639
- CWE-862
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- typescript
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: 4d7899d02ca370a5510406be5c91483085a412f9
  vulnerable_ref: 4d7899d02ca370a5510406be5c91483085a412f9^
  patched_ref: 4d7899d02ca370a5510406be5c91483085a412f9
  repository: https://github.com/FlowiseAI/Flowise
rule:
  message: 'A Stripe subscription/customer ID taken from the request is used for billing calls without
    being

    compared to the session''s active organization subscription/customer ID (or the tenant guards module

    has no assertStripeIdMatchesSession helper). Compare the ID with the session value first.

    '
  pattern-either:
  - patterns:
    - pattern-inside: 'const { ..., $ID, ... } = req.$SRC

        ...

        '
    - metavariable-regex:
        metavariable: $ID
        regex: ^(subscriptionId|customerId)$
    - metavariable-regex:
        metavariable: $IM
        regex: (?i)identityManager$
    - pattern-either:
      - pattern: $IM.$METHOD(..., $ID, ...)
      - pattern: $IM.$METHOD(..., $ID as string, ...)
    - pattern-not-inside: 'assertStripeIdMatchesSession(...)

        ...

        '
  - patterns:
    - pattern: "export function userMayManageOrgUsers(...): $T {\n  ...\n}\n"
    - pattern-not-inside: "export function assertStripeIdMatchesSession(...): $R {\n  ...\n}\n...\n"
fix:
  guidance: Before using a subscriptionId or customerId that comes from the request, compare it with the
    value stored on the authenticated session (req.user.activeOrganizationSubscriptionId or activeOrganizationCustomerId).
    Reject with 403 if the session value is missing or differs. Use assertStripeIdMatchesSession from
    the tenant request guards, or ignore the client-supplied ID and use the session value directly.
  example: "export function assertStripeIdMatchesSession(requestedId: string, activeId: string | undefined):\
    \ void {\n    if (!activeId || requestedId !== activeId) {\n        throw new InternalFlowiseError(StatusCodes.FORBIDDEN,\
    \ GeneralErrorMessage.FORBIDDEN)\n    }\n}\n\nconst { subscriptionId } = req.query\nif (!subscriptionId)\
    \ return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Subscription ID is required' })\nassertStripeIdMatchesSession(subscriptionId\
    \ as string, req.user?.activeOrganizationSubscriptionId)\nconst identityManager = getRunningExpressApp().identityManager\n\
    const result = await identityManager.getAdditionalSeatsQuantity(subscriptionId as string)\n"
